rules: Start at base_score and apply the matching penalty once for each AI finding, regardless of its category.
Clamp the result to minimum_score and maximum_score.
An AI finding with CRITICAL severity sets risk_level to CRITICAL; otherwise risk_level is derived from risk_thresholds.
At or above approve, verdict is APPROVE; at or above approve_with_comments, verdict is APPROVE_WITH_COMMENTS; below that, verdict is DO_NOT_MERGE.

research_rubric.scale: 0-2 per dimension, evaluated manually from captured evidence
